tables.name: users
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `uid` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_method` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `avatar` varchar(500) DEFAULT '',
  `role` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'user',
  `plan` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'free',
  `plan_period` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `plan_expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_username` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_chat_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_group_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `telegram_bot_started_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_joined_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_last_invite_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_credit` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `referred_by` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `bridge_heartbeat` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT (now()),
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `changelog_seen_version` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `plan_source` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `deletion_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `last_seen_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uid` (`uid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `referral_code` (`referral_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_users_phone` (`phone`),
  KEY `idx_users_last_seen` (`last_seen_at`),
  KEY `idx_users_deletion_status` (`deletion_status`,`deleted_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=31 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: bridge_refresh_sessions
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `bridge_refresh_sessions` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_used_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_ip` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `credential_version` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '3',
  `installation_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `generation` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `migration_key` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_fingerprint` char(71) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_refresh_session_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_bridge_refresh_token` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_user` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_expiry` (`expires_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=24 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: ai_model_profiles
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_profiles` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `owner_user_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `scope` enum('user','platform') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `provider` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek',
  `model_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek-chat',
  `api_base_url` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_key_encrypted` text,
  `key_version` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `temperature` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT '0.30',
  `max_tokens` int DEFAULT '2000',
  `thinking_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `reasoning_effort` varchar(16) DEFAULT 'max',
  `request_timeout_ms` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_default` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_default_owner_key` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`is_default` = 1) and (`status` = _utf8mb4'active') and (`deleted_at` is null)) then `owner_user_id` else NULL end)) STORED /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_model_active_default_owner` (`active_default_owner_key`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_scope` (`scope`,`status`,`deleted_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: user_model_defaults
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `user_model_defaults` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `model_profile_id` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_umd_profile` (`model_profile_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: platform_model_usage_policy
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `platform_model_usage_policy` (
  `id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `share_for_manual` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `share_for_auto` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `share_for_review` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `share_for_memory_compression` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `allowed_plans` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `daily_requests_per_user` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '100',
  `daily_tokens_per_user` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '500000',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: ai_model_usage_logs
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_usage_logs` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `model_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `credential_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `usage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `request_phase` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'request',
  `strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `request_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'success',
  `error_code` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `request_bytes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `response_bytes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `duration_ms` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `input_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `output_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reasoning_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cached_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `provider_request_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `finish_reason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `incomplete_details_json` text,
  `accounting_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'estimated',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_user` (`user_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_usage` (`usage`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_provider_request` (`provider_request_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=12140 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: trading_accounts
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `trading_accounts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `broker_server` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `login_account` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `nickname` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `margin_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'netting',
  `review_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `observe_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `is_deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `observed_until` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `identity_verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `anomaly_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_trading_account_identity` (`user_id`,`broker_server`,`login_account`),
  KEY `idx_ta_user` (`user_id`,`is_deleted`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: market_candles
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `market_candles` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `source_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `broker_symbol` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `standard_symbol` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `timeframe` varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  `open_time_utc_msc` bigint NOT NULL,
  `broker_time` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `open_price` decimal(24,10) NOT NULL,
  `high_price` decimal(24,10) NOT NULL,
  `low_price` decimal(24,10) NOT NULL,
  `close_price` decimal(24,10) NOT NULL,
  `tick_volume` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `spread` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_market_candle` (`source_id`,`broker_symbol`,`timeframe`,`open_time_utc_msc`),
  KEY `idx_market_candle_lookup` (`source_id`,`standard_symbol`,`timeframe`,`open_time_utc_msc`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=3530428 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: strategy_subscriptions
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `strategy_subscriptions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `trading_account_id` int NOT NULL,
  `strategy_id` int NOT NULL,
  `risk_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `symbols_json` text,
  `execution_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `memory_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
  `conflicting_strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `schedule_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `schedule_timezone` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'terminal_server',
  `schedule_weekdays_json` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '[1,2,3,4,5]',
  `schedule_windows_json` text,
  `outside_window_behavior` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pause_all',
  `take_profit_mode` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ai_recommended',
  `active_execution_user_key` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`execution_enabled` = 1) and (`is_deleted` = 0)) then `user_id` else NULL end)) STORED /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_subscription_active_execution_user` (`active_execution_user_key`),
  KEY `idx_ss_user_strategy` (`user_id`,`strategy_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_ss_account_strategy` (`trading_account_id`,`strategy_id`,`is_deleted`),
  KEY `idx_ss_account_exec` (`trading_account_id`,`execution_enabled`,`is_deleted`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: inference_snapshots
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `inference_snapshots` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `signal_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `strategy_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `strategy_scope` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `owner_user_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `standard_symbol` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `market_source` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `system_prompt` longtext NOT NULL,
  `user_prompt` longtext NOT NULL,
  `prompt_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `model_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `model_name` varchar(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `credential_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `output_schema_version` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `klines_json` longtext,
  `market_snapshot_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `strategy_runtime_json` longtext,
  `memory_mode` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off',
  `evidence_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete',
  `omitted_fields_json` text,
  `content_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `byte_size` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_inference_snapshot_signal` (`signal_id`),
  KEY `idx_inference_snapshot_strategy` (`strategy_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_inference_snapshot_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=10272 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

tables.name: ai_model_tasks
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_tasks` (
  `task_id` char(36) NOT NULL,
  `task_kind` varchar(48) NOT NULL,
  `queue_class` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'background',
  `owner_user_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `domain_type` varchar(48) DEFAULT NULL,
  `domain_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `snapshot_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `input_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `prompt_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `output_contract_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_provider` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_model` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_model_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_protocol` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_credential_source` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `frozen_context_json` longtext,
  `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
  `priority` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `attempt_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `max_attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `scheduled_at_utc_msc` bigint NOT NULL,
  `task_deadline_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_valid_until_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_token` char(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fencing_token` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lease_owner` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_expires_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_activity_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `estimated_input_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `selected_output_budget` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `schema_need_tokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `context_window_tokens` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_max_input_tokens` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `context_limit_semantics` varchar(24) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_limits_source` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_limits_status` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_limits_updated_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_output_cap` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_ref` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `finish_reason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `incomplete_details_json` text,
  `error_code` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_message` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completed_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc_msc` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc_msc` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`task_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_model_task_idempotency` (`task_kind`,`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `idx_model_task_claim` (`queue_class`,`status`,`priority`,`scheduled_at_utc_msc`),
  KEY `idx_model_task_lease` (`status`,`lease_expires_at_utc_msc`),
  KEY `idx_model_task_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`created_at_utc_msc`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
